plugins.description: Multi-model council and swarm control plane. Adds MetaLoop: Fable 5 as CEO (frames every run) + GPT Chief Operator + expert (Grok, OpenCode/GLM) and fast (two Antigravity/Gemini 3.5 Flash sessions) labor tiers, with typed contracts, risk-aware routing, correlation-aware consensus, real-repo proposal mode, and deterministic gates.
